<a id="api-AdminOptions"></a>

## [INTERFACE] `AdminOptions`

Host capabilities for resource authorization, tenant-scoped SQL and durable audit.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin`.

### Signature

```typescript
interface AdminOptions {
    resources: AdminResource[];
    authorize(principal: PluginPrincipal, resource: AdminResource): Promise<boolean>;
    driver(principal: PluginPrincipal): RecordSqlDriver;
    audit(event: {
        principal: PluginPrincipal;
        resourceId: string;
        operation: 'list' | 'schema' | 'read';
        count?: number;
    }): Promise<void>;
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resources` | `AdminResource[]` | Yes | Explicit host resource catalog; cloned when routes are constructed. |
| `authorize` | `Promise<boolean>` | Yes | Live plugin activation, admin role and resource-permission check; must resolve true for access. |
| `driver` | `RecordSqlDriver` | Yes | Return a tenant-aware SQL driver; errors propagate to the request. |
| `audit` | `Promise<void>` | Yes | Persist a durable metadata-only audit receipt before returning data; failures deny the response, and record payloads must not be logged. |

### Returns

Type declaration; no runtime value.

### See also

createAdminRoutes for a complete host integration example.

### Public members

#### `resources`

Explicit host resource catalog; cloned when routes are constructed.


#### `authorize`

Live plugin activation, admin role and resource-permission check; must resolve true for access.

Parameters:

- `principal`: Verified tenant principal for this operation.
- `resource`: Host-catalog resource identifier.

Returns: True only when current host policy allows access; false denies access.

### Remarks

Must check current plugin activation, admin role AND resource permission.

### Errors and rejections

Propagates host adapter or SDK failures; async methods reject their Promise.

Example:

```typescript
import type { AdminOptions, AdminResource } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin';
import type { PluginPrincipal } from '@alneas/eaos-server/plugin-data';
export function canInspect(options: AdminOptions, principal: PluginPrincipal, resource: AdminResource) {
 return options.authorize(principal, resource);
}
```


#### `driver`

Return a tenant-aware SQL driver; errors propagate to the request.

Parameters:

- `principal`: Verified tenant principal for this operation.

Returns: A tenant-aware SQL driver.

### Errors and rejections

Propagates host adapter or SDK failures; async methods reject their Promise.

Example:

```typescript
import type { AdminOptions } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin';
import type { PluginPrincipal } from '@alneas/eaos-server/plugin-data';
export function tenantDriver(options: AdminOptions, principal: PluginPrincipal) {
 return options.driver(principal); // Keep tenant predicates in all SQL executed through this driver.
}
```


#### `audit`

Persist a durable metadata-only audit receipt before returning data; failures deny the response, and record payloads must not be logged.

Parameters:

- `event`: Message or error event delivered by the host worker.

Returns: Resolves without a value after a durable receipt is written.

### Remarks

Durable audit receipt required before returning data; no record payloads are logged.

### Errors and rejections

Propagates host adapter or SDK failures; async methods reject their Promise.

Example:

```typescript
import type { AdminOptions } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin';
import type { PluginPrincipal } from '@alneas/eaos-server/plugin-data';
export async function recordInspection(options: AdminOptions, principal: PluginPrincipal, resourceId: string, count: number) {
 await options.audit({ principal, resourceId, operation: 'read', count });
 // Return protected results only after this durable acknowledgement and a fresh authorization check.
}
```


#### `audit.event.principal`

Verified current tenant/user principal responsible for the admitted resource operation.


#### `audit.event.resourceId`

Explicit trusted admin resource catalog ID; never a request-selected SQL table name.


#### `audit.event.operation`

Reported metadata-list, schema-inspection or data-read phase; audit is durably acknowledged before data is returned.


#### `audit.event.count`

Optional returned or verified row/event count; omitted for catalog and schema inspection.

<a id="api-AdminResource"></a>

## [INTERFACE] `AdminResource`

Explicit trusted read-only table projection and optional existing command journal.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin`.

### Signature

```typescript
interface AdminResource {
    journal?: AtomicRepository;
    recordNamespace?: string;
    id: string;
    label: string;
    table: string;
    tenantColumn: string;
    keyColumn: string;
    columns: {
        name: string;
        label: string;
        type: 'string' | 'number' | 'boolean';
    }[];
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `journal` | `AtomicRepository` | No | Optional existing host-owned AtomicRepository; no discovery or journal creation is performed. |
| `recordNamespace` | `string` | No | Optional canonical record namespace restricting key prefixes; lowercase identifier, maximum 63 characters. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Unique trusted resource identifier, maximum 63 SQL-safe identifier characters. |
| `label` | `string` | Yes | Public catalog caption. |
| `table` | `string` | Yes | Trusted SQL table identifier; no user-supplied table names. |
| `tenantColumn` | `string` | Yes | SQL column constrained to the authenticated tenant on every query. |
| `keyColumn` | `string` | Yes | Stable SQL key used for ordering and optional namespace prefix checks. |
| `columns` | `{     name: string;     label: string;     type: 'string' \| 'number' \| 'boolean'; }[]` | Yes | Nonempty allowlist of at most 100 unique case-insensitive column names, public captions and scalar types. |

### Returns

Type declaration; no runtime value.

### See also

createAdminRoutes for a complete host integration example.

### Public members

#### `journal`

Optional existing host-owned AtomicRepository; no discovery or journal creation is performed.

### Remarks

Explicit host-owned existing command journal; no table discovery.


#### `recordNamespace`

Optional canonical record namespace restricting key prefixes; lowercase identifier, maximum 63 characters.


#### `id`

Unique trusted resource identifier, maximum 63 SQL-safe identifier characters.


#### `label`

Public catalog caption.


#### `table`

Trusted SQL table identifier; no user-supplied table names.


#### `tenantColumn`

SQL column constrained to the authenticated tenant on every query.


#### `keyColumn`

Stable SQL key used for ordering and optional namespace prefix checks.


#### `columns`

Nonempty allowlist of at most 100 unique case-insensitive column names, public captions and scalar types.

### Remarks

Only these columns can be selected or filtered. Do not expose credentials or internal control tables.


#### `columns[].name`

Allowlisted SQL column name; never expose credentials.


#### `columns[].label`

Public catalog caption.


#### `columns[].type`

Native text input type; defaults to text.

<a id="api-createAdminRoutes"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `createAdminRoutes`

Creates a read-only admin router over an explicit resource catalog with repeated authorization and durable audit.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function createAdminRoutes(options: AdminOptions, resolvePrincipal: (c: Context) => Promise<PluginPrincipal | null>): hono.Hono<_alneas_eaos_server_plugin_data.PluginHttpEnv, hono_types.BlankSchema, "/">;
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `AdminOptions` | Yes | Live host persistence and authorization configuration; see AdminOptions. |
| `resolvePrincipal` | `(c: Context) => Promise<PluginPrincipal \| null>` | Yes | Resolves current authenticated principal per Hono request, or null to deny access. |

### Returns

`hono.Hono<_alneas_eaos_server_plugin_data.PluginHttpEnv, hono_types.BlankSchema, "/">`

A Hono router ready to mount under the plugin API prefix.

### Remarks

The host owns authentication, current tenant membership and plugin activation. Service errors become HTTP failures through the plugin router; adapter failures may propagate. Mutations can commit before a response failure; reload current state before retrying.

### Errors and rejections

Construction rejects invalid host/schema bindings or malformed/duplicate resource catalog identifiers.

### Example

```typescript
import { createAdminRoutes, type AdminOptions } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin';
export function connectRoutes(options: AdminOptions, resolvePrincipal: Parameters<typeof createAdminRoutes>[1]) {
 return createAdminRoutes(options, resolvePrincipal);
}
```


<a id="api-createExtension"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `createExtension`

Builds a host extension restricted to a verified, concrete tenant catalog.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin/runtime`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function createExtension(input: {
    tenantIds: string[];
    bindings?: PublicPluginBindings;
}): {
    apiVersion: 1;
    id: string;
    tenantIds: string[];
    manifests: _alneas_eaos_core.PluginManifest[];
    lifecycle: _alneas_eaos_server_lifecycle_engine.LifecyclePlugin[];
    routeFactories: {
        [x: string]: (options?: any) => any;
    };
};
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `{     tenantIds: string[];     bindings?: PublicPluginBindings; }` | Yes | Nonempty distinct concrete tenantIds plus required live bindings; wildcard IDs are rejected. |

### Returns

`{     apiVersion: 1;     id: string;     tenantIds: string[];     manifests: _alneas_eaos_core.PluginManifest[];     lifecycle: _alneas_eaos_server_lifecycle_engine.LifecyclePlugin[];     routeFactories: {         [x: string]: (options?: any) => any;     }; }`

An API-version-1 extension containing tenant IDs, configured manifest, lifecycle and route factories.

### Remarks

This validates adapter presence and tenant admission, not the truth of host authorization. No activation or migration is executed. Principals outside the configured catalog resolve to null.

### Errors and rejections

Error for empty/duplicate/wildcard tenant IDs or missing host adapter functions.

### Public members

#### `input.tenantIds`

Verified nonempty catalog of distinct concrete tenant IDs; wildcards are rejected.


#### `input.bindings`

Required live host options and identity resolver; omitted bindings throw.



### Example

```typescript
import { createExtension, type PublicPluginBindings } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin/runtime';
export function configureExtension(tenantIds: string[], bindings: PublicPluginBindings) { return createExtension({ tenantIds, bindings }); }
```


<a id="api-createPlugin"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `createPlugin`

Binds static plugin metadata to the host-configured route factory.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function createPlugin(options: AdminOptions, resolvePrincipal: (c: Context) => Promise<PluginPrincipal | null>): PluginManifest;
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `AdminOptions` | Yes | Live host configuration; see AdminOptions. |
| `resolvePrincipal` | `(c: Context) => Promise<PluginPrincipal \| null>` | Yes | Current authenticated Hono principal resolver; null denies admission. |

### Returns

`PluginManifest`

A cloned PluginManifest with a createRoutes closure; no routes are instantiated until called.

### Remarks

Supplying a manifest does not activate a tenant or perform migrations. Host admission and live authorization remain mandatory.

### Example

```typescript
import { createPlugin, type AdminOptions } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/admin';
export function configure(options: AdminOptions, resolvePrincipal: Parameters<typeof createPlugin>[1]) { return createPlugin(options, resolvePrincipal); }
```
